home.description: Left-rail Library overview at /library/ag with search, view controls, collections, and draft cards.

nodes.title: Library
nodes.notes: Ordinary landing view at /library/ag; stable reset/home surface.

nodes.title: New Brand
nodes.notes: Brand options > New Brand immediately creates and navigates to a new Untitled Brand brand kit.

nodes.title: Rename Brand
nodes.notes: Brand options > Rename Brand; edit Brand name textbox, then click Done.

nodes.title: New Workflow
nodes.notes: Creates a brand-scoped workflow inline; Save Changes commits and Cancel exits.

nodes.title: Workflow row
nodes.notes: Saved workflow is shown as a clickable name+description row.

nodes.title: Background colors
nodes.notes: Swatch list with Add Background; changes require Save Changes.

nodes.title: Text colors
nodes.notes: Swatch list with Add Text Color; changes require Save Changes.

nodes.title: Paint picker
nodes.notes: Supports Solid, Linear, Radial, Multi, Image, Shader paints.

nodes.title: Color notes
nodes.notes: Guidance for color usage/palette rationale.

nodes.title: Color actions
nodes.notes: Overflow menu on each swatch; Make Default disabled for the current default.

nodes.title: Primary Font
nodes.notes: Click searchable font field, choose a font from the large list; save or cancel.

nodes.title: Secondary Font
nodes.notes: Searchable font field; may be None.

nodes.title: Text Style Editor
nodes.notes: Modal launched by New Text Style; fields: style name, preview text, font family/weight/size, line height, letter spacing.

nodes.title: Screen Shadow
nodes.notes: Opacity, blur, spread and X/Y offset.

nodes.title: Layout notes
nodes.notes: Multiline brand layout guidance; edits require Save Changes.

nodes.title: Misc notes
nodes.notes: Catch-all brand guidance; edits require Save Changes.

nodes.title: Draft editor
nodes.notes: Core editor at /ag-editor/{id}; contains Script/Agent pane, scene canvas, timeline, agent composer, voice, project actions, color, music, publish/export.

nodes.title: Draft title
nodes.notes: Top textbox; edits auto-save.

nodes.title: Screen Recording Settings
nodes.notes: Per-draft override panel reached from Project actions; Done closes/saves.

nodes.title: Cursor Style
nodes.notes: Combobox; selection updates immediately inside Screen Recording Settings, then use Done.

nodes.title: Screen shadow
nodes.notes: Opacity, blur, spread, X and Y offsets.

nodes.title: Default Zoom Type
nodes.notes: Includes Default Zoom Level slider.

nodes.title: Version History
nodes.notes: Right-side panel listing restorable document versions; reverting a version affects the current draft.

nodes.title: Voice picker
nodes.notes: Narration voice picker with English, World, Creative tabs and speed control.

nodes.title: Narration voice
nodes.notes: World tab additionally has localized voices; clicking assigns immediately.

nodes.title: Voice speed
nodes.notes: Shown as Default Speed at the bottom of the voice picker.

nodes.title: Add Reference...
nodes.notes: Appears to invoke an OS/browser file chooser; no in-page picker was exposed.

nodes.title: Image generation picker
nodes.notes: Open by selecting Image composer mode, then click the model button (e.g. Gemini).

nodes.title: Composer mode
nodes.notes: Image exposes image-model settings; Video returns to Multi model button.

nodes.title: Save as default
nodes.notes: Button in image model picker; likely persists selected generation settings as default.

nodes.title: Video generation picker
nodes.notes: Open by selecting Video composer mode, then click the Multi credit button.

nodes.title: Preferred Duration
nodes.notes: Changing duration updates credit estimate.

nodes.title: Make a copy
nodes.notes: Immediately creates and opens a new duplicate named Copy of {title}.

nodes.title: Draft scene
nodes.notes: Each added scene appears as a script block and a 5-second timeline segment by default.

nodes.title: Canvas paint picker
nodes.notes: Live document canvas background styling.

nodes.title: Shader paint
nodes.notes: Controls Base/Mid Accent/Accent colors plus Speed, Seed, Noise, Saturation.

nodes.title: Radial paint controls
nodes.notes: Gradient endpoints on canvas; stops support position, color, opacity, flip, rotate 90°, add/remove.

nodes.title: Multi paint controls
nodes.notes: Draggable canvas points; add/remove stops, per-stop color and opacity, Blend.

nodes.title: Add Music
nodes.notes: Upload-only popover for MP3/WAV/M4A background track.

nodes.title: Upload background track MP3 / WAV / M4A
nodes.notes: Invokes file upload chooser.

nodes.title: Canvas caption/text styling toolbar
nodes.notes: Opened by unlabeled top-right icon right of background paint; shows selected bottom caption box.

nodes.title: Font family
nodes.notes: Current Cereal.

nodes.title: Font weight
nodes.notes: Current Medium.

nodes.title: Font size
nodes.notes: Current 48.

nodes.title: Brand assignment
nodes.notes: Hover Project actions > Brand to open submenu; current brand is shown in the parent item.

nodes.title: Canvas media upload panel
nodes.notes: Large blank overlay; only unlabeled bottom upload icon. No built-in library observed.

nodes.title: Upload media
nodes.notes: Invokes non-driveable file chooser; no in-page picker.

nodes.title: Record Camera / Screen
nodes.notes: Click canvas-bottom camera icon to reveal; activation had no driveable in-page result.

nodes.title: Undo
nodes.notes: First unlabeled header button before Project actions.

nodes.title: Redo
nodes.notes: Second unlabeled header button before Project actions.

nodes.title: Timeline Zoom
nodes.notes: Click button to open slider; adjust directly; Reset appears after change.

nodes.title: Copy Transcript
nodes.notes: Project actions command; copies transcript to clipboard.

nodes.title: Screen Studio Import
nodes.notes: Import likely invokes native/browser file chooser; no driveable in-page UI appeared.

nodes.title: Rename draft
nodes.notes: Inline title textbox on the card; saves live.

nodes.title: Add to Collection
nodes.notes: Card overflow action; opens collection checkbox picker, selection applies immediately.

nodes.title: Collection picker
nodes.notes: Compact checkbox list of available collections.

nodes.title: Move to workspace
nodes.notes: Immediate card overflow action; no confirmation. Destructive-to-location for existing content.

nodes.title: Duplicate Brand
nodes.notes: Immediately creates and opens a copied brand named '{original} Copy'; no confirmation.

nodes.title: Archive Brand
nodes.notes: Under Brand options; destructive and harness-guarded.

nodes.title: Template Editor
nodes.notes: Per-template editing surface at /template-editor/{id}; created from a brand's Templates tab.

nodes.title: Creation tools
nodes.notes: Group, Text, Media, Shape tools.

nodes.title: Duplicate Template
nodes.notes: Immediate copy, no confirmation; navigates to new template and suffixes title with Copy.

nodes.title: Performance Mode
nodes.notes: Per-template counterpart to draft editor performance mode.

nodes.title: Template Canvas Size
nodes.notes: Applies immediately and closes the menu.

nodes.title: Playback Loop
nodes.notes: Immediate menu checkbox; menu stays open.

nodes.title: Delete Template
nodes.notes: Destructive.

nodes.title: Shape inspector
nodes.notes: Position, size, transform, background, border, shadow, blur.

nodes.title: Media picker
nodes.notes: Blank modal with only an unlabeled upload control.

nodes.title: Save template image settings as default
Save template video settings as default
Group Border
nodes.notes: Enable from Group inspector section row; exposes paint picker/hex and border width.

nodes.title: Group Shadow
nodes.notes: Enable from Group inspector; controls color, opacity, X/Y offsets, blur, spread.

nodes.title: Group Blur
nodes.notes: Enable from Group inspector; one numeric amount.

nodes.title: Template Inspector
nodes.notes: Shown with no layer selected; duration, opacity, layout, background, motion blur, description, previews.

nodes.title: Template Background
nodes.notes: Optional paint; enabling applies 1A1A2E solid at 100% and exposes paint picker.

nodes.title: Template Description
nodes.notes: Description for the agent.

nodes.title: Template Motion Blur
nodes.notes: Optional numeric amount; default 50 when enabled.

nodes.title: Webcam Preview
nodes.notes: Template-level inspector; painted selector did not open via CDP click.

nodes.title: Project BG Preview
nodes.notes: Template preview-only background color at bottom of template-level inspector.

nodes.title: Circle layer
nodes.notes: Created through Shape... > Circle (O); ellipse-* layer with standard shape inspector.

nodes.title: Polygon layer
nodes.notes: Triangle creates a polygon layer with vertex count 3; Polygon primitive uses the same inspector.

nodes.title: Polygon sides
nodes.notes: Top numeric field; Triangle defaults to 3.

nodes.title: Polygon corner radius
nodes.notes: Numeric field in polygon inspector; default 0.

nodes.title: Line layer
nodes.notes: Shape... > Line (L); vector-* layer.

nodes.title: Line stroke
nodes.notes: Paint, opacity, width, and style.

nodes.title: Line arrow
nodes.notes: Optional Arrow section.

nodes.title: Arrow Layer
nodes.notes: Vector layer; line-style inspector with Arrow enabled by default.

nodes.title: Arrow Options
nodes.notes: Arrow shape defaults: End, Triangle, size 6.

nodes.title: Icon Layer
nodes.notes: SF Symbols-style icon layer, default star.fill.

nodes.title: Icon Symbol
nodes.notes: Click current symbol field, search/browse, then click a named symbol; applies immediately and closes.

nodes.title: Icon Style
nodes.notes: Paint, opacity, position, rotation and size.

nodes.title: Icon Symbol Picker
nodes.notes: Searchable picker with common symbols plus thousands of SF Symbols-style names.

nodes.title: Pen tool
nodes.notes: Shape > Pen (P/V); selecting it does not immediately create a layer. A single canvas click had no observable result.

edges.action: click "New Draft" in the main toolbar or "New draft" in the sidebar
click "Settings" at bottom of left sidebar
scroll down within Settings to integration buttons
click "Brand Kits", then choose a brand (for example "Default Brand · Primary")
save a workflow, then click its row
click “New draft” (immediately creates an Untitled draft)
click English, World, or Creative tab
click Image composer mode, then click the current model button (e.g. Gemini)
click Video composer mode, then click the Multi credit button
open Project actions and choose an aspect-ratio item
open Project actions and choose under Performance Mode
click unlabeled icon immediately right of Open paint picker
click Project actions, then hover Brand
click unlabeled upload icon at bottom center
click canvas-bottom camera icon, then click Record Camera / Screen
click first unlabeled header button before Project actions
click second unlabeled header button before Project actions
scroll to Integrations and click Import under Screen Studio Import
click Your Drafts in left sidebar
click New Draft (creates a draft immediately)
click the ellipsis on a draft card
click Brand options, then Archive Brand
click New Template; template is created immediately
use Group, Text, Media, or Shape controls below canvas
click Text; a new text layer is added and selected
choose a shape such as Rectangle
on Image tab, click current model button (for example Gemini)
select Video, then click Multi credit/model button
click Duplicate Template; wait for copied template to load
use Arrow section in right inspector
click current symbol name (for example star.fill)
click the current symbol field in the Icon inspector
click a named symbol such as heart
